# App Store Search Metadata Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Follow this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Update the homepage title and description to match the recommended app store/search positioning for Staia.

**Architecture:** Keep homepage metadata owned by `src/pages/index.html` front matter, then rebuild generated static output through Eleventy. Do not edit `dist` directly; it is generated from source.

**Tech Stack:** Eleventy, Nunjucks front matter, static HTML metadata.

---

### Task 1: Homepage Metadata

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/pages/index.html`
- Generated by build: `dist/index.html`

- [x] **Step 1: Update homepage front matter**

Change the homepage front matter to:

```yaml
title: "Staia: AI Astrology Chat"
description: "Ask about love, timing, and your birth chart with personal AI astrology."
```

Expected: the source homepage no longer uses the generic `Staia` title or `Staia is a personal astrology app.` description.

- [x] **Step 2: Build the static site**

Run:

```bash
npm run build
```

Expected: Eleventy writes `dist/index.html` with the new `<title>` and meta description.

Execution note: this shell did not have `npm` on `PATH`, so the equivalent build command was used:

```bash
rm -rf dist && /Users/markvasilyev/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node node_modules/@11ty/eleventy/cmd.cjs
```

- [x] **Step 3: Inspect generated metadata**

Run:

```bash
rg -n "Staia: AI Astrology Chat|Ask about love, timing, and your birth chart with personal AI astrology" dist/index.html
```

Expected: `dist/index.html` contains both the new title and description.

- [x] **Step 4: Verify homepage in browser**

Serve the generated site:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8080/` in the Codex browser and verify:

```js
document.title === "Staia: AI Astrology Chat"
document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]').content === "Ask about love, timing, and your birth chart with personal AI astrology."
```

Expected: the homepage loads without console errors and browser metadata matches the recommendation.

- [x] **Step 5: Run static hygiene checks**

Run:

```bash
git diff --check
```

Expected: no whitespace errors.

- [x] **Step 6: Commit and push**

Run:

```bash
git add src/pages/index.html docs/plans/2026-06-10-app-store-search-metadata.md
git commit -m "Update homepage search metadata"
git push -u origin codex/app-store-search-metadata
```

Expected: the branch is pushed and ready for a pull request into `main`.
